FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Can we add new weddings ourselves?

Yes. Publishing a new gallery is a straightforward CMS task with bulk upload and automatic image optimisation.

Should we show our prices?

Usually a starting range, which filters out mismatched enquiries without ruling out bespoke work. We will advise based on your market.

Will large galleries slow the site down?

Not the way we build them. Images are optimised on upload and loaded progressively as the visitor scrolls.

How long does it take?

Around six to eight weeks, depending on how much photography needs organising.
